name: +1 Pickaxe Swing for Eggs
desc:
Welcome to +1 Pickaxe Swing for Eggs ⛏️🥚

Swing your Pickaxes, break through blocks, and hatch as many Animals as you can! Upgrade your Pickaxe Swing to destroy stronger blocks, reach new areas, discover better Eggs, and hatch rare Animals! 🐾✨

How to play:
⛏️ Swing to gain +1 Pickaxe Swing  
🧱 Break Blocks to progress through new areas  
🥚 Find & Hatch Eggs for Animals  
💥 Get stronger Pickaxes to break blocks faster  
🐶 Collect rare Animals to earn more Cash  
💵 Upgrade your Animals to boost your income  
🏗️ Expand your base to hold even more Animals  

💤 Your Animals generate Cash even while OFFLINE!

♻️ Rebirth to multiply your Cash and become even stronger!

👍 Like the game and join the group for a FREE Animal!
